rule: Kept by hand. UCDP's early monthly rows have no published totals to compare with, so each early row of 1,000 deaths or more is read in UCDP's file before the build may count it, and logged here with a verdict (keep, or leave out), the reason, the date and who read it. scripts/build_ucdp.py stops on a large early row that is not here or has changed since it was read.

rows.why: Protesters killed by Iran's government in January 2026, flagged by UCDP to check the type of violence. A separate one-sided conflict, not the war; the build leaves the whole dyad out and the map says so.

rows.dyad: Government of Russia (Soviet Union) - Government of Ukraine
rows.why: Russia's documented losses for the month, from Poteru. UCDP's usual monthly row for this war: the reviewed 2025 file has the same row each month, from 2,955 to 8,951.
